name: agent-bridge
description: Launch configurable external agent CLIs as linked child tasks with model, reasoning, session, and result controls.

interface.longDescription: Start linked external child-agent tasks in locally installed command-line tools such as Claude Code or Antigravity CLI. Select provider models and reasoning effort, wait for bounded output, resume supported conversations, or cancel work through commands controlled by a JSON parameter file.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-bridge to list configured agents and delegate a task.
Ask a configured external agent to review this repository.
Check the status and output of my Agent Bridge tasks.
